children: Aldel Financial II announced that the sponsor and other holders will convert nearly all Class B shares into Class A shares effective October 5, 2026.
The sponsor will convert all but one Class B share into Class A on Oct 5, 2026, under the amended articles.
Other Class B holders will also convert; converted shares waive any right to Trust Account funds.
No additional funds were deposited into the Trust Account in respect of the converted shares.
Post-conversion capitalization: 29,868,213 Class A shares outstanding and one Class B share held by the sponsor.
